# Reporte de inputs de ui-angular

Inventario de **1,567 inputs** de componentes y directivas, exportado desde [el CSV](ui-angular-inputs.csv).

## Alcance y criterios

- Cada entrada corresponde a un input declarado en el código. Los inputs de `model()` permiten enlace bidireccional.
- Se separan los elementos de la biblioteca de los componentes auxiliares de Storybook. Los elementos sin inputs no generan entradas.
- Los tipos y valores predeterminados conservan las expresiones del código fuente; no se evalúan los valores dinámicos.
- Las descripciones conservan su idioma original. Se indica cuando no hay descripción o cuando su expresión no se pudo resolver automáticamente.
- Las rutas son relativas a la raíz del repositorio. Las líneas y la documentación corresponden a la versión utilizada para generar el CSV.

## Resumen

| Ámbito | Componentes con inputs | Directivas con inputs | Inputs |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Biblioteca | 185 | 13 | 1478 |
| Storybook | 17 | 0 | 89 |

- Con descripción recuperada: **1194**.
- Sin descripción documentada: **337**.
- Descripción no resuelta automáticamente: **36**.

- Propiedad de la clase: ` mode `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IBmbAIChatCardMode `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` 'expanded' `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-ai-chat-card/bmb-ai-chat-card.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-ai-chat-card/bmb-ai-chat-card.component.ts), línea **75**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the appearance of mode, affecting its visual style.
> > [!CALLOUT]
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> >
> Flows automatically supported by the component:
>  - "compact" -> "chat" (collapsing) -> compact
>  - "chat" (expanding) -> "expanded"
>  - "expanded" (collapsing) -> "chat"
>  - "invisible" -> "chat" (collapsing) -> invisible
> 
>       
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >
> If the AI chat card is in "expanded" mode, it will occupy the full available space, so we recommend redirect to a page where it can be used exclusively for this purpose in layouts where this behavior is desired.
>         
> 
> The "invisible" mode allows you to hide the "AI chat card"; to show it, you simply need to change the mode value to "chat".
> 
> In the case where the "invisible" mode is switched to "chat" mode via an external implementation, it automatically reverts to "invisible" upon collapsing.,

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-ai-chat-card/bmb-ai-chat-card.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-ai-chat-card/bmb-ai-chat-card.stories.ts), línea **126**.

- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts), línea **66**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the bade info: text, appearance, and container.
> 
> Badge info properties:
> - `text`: (string) Sets the text of the badge. The width will increase depending on the length of the text..
> 
> - `appearance`: (optional, string) Sets the appearance of the badge, affecting its visual style.
> 
>   **Default appearance**: normal.
> 
>   ✳️**Note**
>  disabled and background do not exist for container.
> 
> - `container`: (optional, boolean) Sets the container flag. This displays the container when true; if false, it displays a bullet.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts), línea **149**.

#### ` icon `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` icon `.
- Tipo de dato: ` string `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` '' `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts), línea **67**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the name of the icon to be displayed.
> 
> > [!CALLOUT]
> ⚙️**Configuration**
> 
> >Please refer to [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/icons?icon.size=24&icon.color=%23e8eaed&icon.style=Rounded&icon.set=Material+Symbols) for more icons and make sure that you have selected the filters:
> - Fill
> - Style:
>  - Material Symbols
>  - Rounded
> 
> ‼️These filters are important to ensure that you are choosing an icon that meets the guidelines of ***Bamboo***‼️.
> 
> > [!NOTE]
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> >Images are also supported; instead of the icon name, enter the URL or path of the image to use.
> 
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.
> Look for the property to set the alt, if it does not exist in the component it is because the component implements it internally.
> 
> Examples:
> 
> - `info`: Displays an information icon.
> - `settings`: Displays a settings icon.
> 
> Usage:
> 
> ```html
> <bmb-icon [icon]="'info'"></bmb-icon>
> ```

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts), línea **257**.

#### ` menuItems `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` menuItems `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IDropdownItem[] `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` [] `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts), línea **72**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the data to be displayed in the dropdown menu.
> 
> It is an array of objects representing menu items, providing additional actions or navigation options within the card button.
> 
> Each object in the array should contain the following properties:
> 
> - `icon`: (string) The name of the icon displayed next to the menu item text.
> 
> - `text`: (string) The text label for the menu item.
> 
> - `url`: (optional, string) The URL to navigate to when the menu item is clicked.
> 
> - `target`: (optional, string) Specifies where to display the linked URL (e.g., `_self`, `_blank`).
> 
> - `action`: (optional, function) A custom function executed when the menu item is clicked, this event is only emitted if the *link* property is empty. This is useful for triggering specific behaviors or events.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.stories.ts), línea **198**.

#### ` isTemplate `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` isTemplate `.
- Tipo de dato: ` boolean `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` false `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-card-button/bmb-card-button.component.ts), línea **73**.

**Descripción**

> Enables the use of templates so that icons appear before the drop-down menu. You cannot place more than four icons or action icon or bookmark.
> 
> **HTML architecture**
> 
> ```
> <bmb-card-button>
>   
>     <bmb-action-icon />
>     <bmb-icon />
>     <bmb-bookmark />
>   
> </bmb-card-button>
> ```
> 
> ✳️**Note**
>  there is an example in the **Template example** the section.

>     });
>     
>

- Propiedad de la clase: ` errorMessage `.
- Tipo de dato: ` string | IBmbInputError `.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

**Descripción**

> Sets custom validator function to the field.
> 
> Example of a `ValidatorFn`
>     handleCustomValidator(): ValidatorFn {
>       return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
>         const { value } = control;
>         if (!value) return null;
> 
>         if (value === 'value example') return { customValidation: true };
> 
>         return null;
>       };
>     }

#### ` control `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.

- Valor predeterminado: ` newFormControlByType('checkbox') `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.

- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-checkbox/bmb-checkbox.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-checkbox/bmb-checkbox.component.ts), línea **47**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-checkbox/bmb-checkbox.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-checkbox/bmb-checkbox.stories.ts), línea **132**.

> >Please refer to [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/icons?icon.size=24&icon.color=%23e8eaed&icon.style=Rounded&icon.set=Material+Symbols) for more icons and make sure that you have selected the filters:

>

> 
> > [!NOTE]

> 
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.
> Look for the property to set the alt, if it does not exist in the component it is because the component implements it internally.

**Descripción**

> Sets the bade info: text, appearance, and container.
> 
> Badge info properties:
> - `text`: (string) Sets the text of the badge. The width will increase depending on the length of the text..
> 
> - `appearance`: (optional, string) Sets the appearance of the badge, affecting its visual style.
> 
>   **Default appearance**: normal.
> 
>   ✳️**Note**
>  disabled and background do not exist for container.
> 
> - `container`: (optional, boolean) Sets the container flag. This displays the container when true; if false, it displays a bullet.

#### ` dropdownMenuItems `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` dropdownMenuItems `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IDropdownItem[] `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` [] `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-container-button/bmb-container-button.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-container-button/bmb-container-button.component.ts), línea **75**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the data to be displayed in the dropdown menu.
> 
> It is an array of objects representing menu items, providing additional actions or navigation options within the card button.
> 
> Each object in the array should contain the following properties:
> 
> - `icon`: (string) The name of the icon displayed next to the menu item text.
> 
> - `text`: (string) The text label for the menu item.
> 
> - `url`: (optional, string) The URL to navigate to when the menu item is clicked.
> 
> - `target`: (optional, string) Specifies where to display the linked URL (e.g., `_self`, `_blank`).
> 
> - `action`: (optional, function) A custom function executed when the menu item is clicked, this event is only emitted if the *link* property is empty. This is useful for triggering specific behaviors or events.

**Descripción**

> Sets custom validator function to the field.
> 
> Example of a `ValidatorFn`
>     handleCustomValidator(): ValidatorFn {
>       return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
>         const { value } = control;
>         if (!value) return null;
> 
>         if (value === 'value example') return { customValidation: true };
> 
>         return null;
>       };
>     }

- Propiedad de la clase: ` errorMessage `.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormControl `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` newFormControlByType() `.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

**Descripción**

> Sets custom validator function to the field.
> 
> Example of a `ValidatorFn`
>     handleCustomValidator(): ValidatorFn {
>       return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
>         const { value } = control;
>         if (!value) return null;
> 
>         if (value === 'value example') return { customValidation: true };
> 
>         return null;
>       };
>     }

- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-date-range/bmb-date-range.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-date-range/bmb-date-range.component.ts), línea **55**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

> Sets the name of the icon to be displayed.
> 
> > [!CALLOUT]
> ⚙️**Configuration**
> 
> >Please refer to [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/icons?icon.size=24&icon.color=%23e8eaed&icon.style=Rounded&icon.set=Material+Symbols) for more icons and make sure that you have selected the filters:
> - Fill
> - Style:
>  - Material Symbols
>  - Rounded
> 
> ‼️These filters are important to ensure that you are choosing an icon that meets the guidelines of ***Bamboo***‼️.
> 
> > [!NOTE]
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> >Images are also supported; instead of the icon name, enter the URL or path of the image to use.
> 
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.
> Look for the property to set the alt, if it does not exist in the component it is because the component implements it internally.
> 
> The icon to display within the field.

#### ` errorMessage `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` errorMessage `.
- Tipo de dato: ` string | IBmbInputError `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` '' `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.component.ts), línea **77**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.stories.ts), línea **253**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the list of options to display at the top of the data.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> The order given will be the position in which it will be displayed.
> 
> **Considerations**
> 
> If the data is a list of string type, the preferred options should be a fragment of the data.
> 
> **Example**:
>     [options]="[
>       'Apple name',
>       'Banana name',
>       'Orange name',
>       'Pear name',
>       'Grape name',
>     ]"
> 
>     [preferredOptions]="[
>       'Grape name',
>       'Orange name',
>     ]"
> 
> If the data is a list of  IBmbDropdownItem type, the preferred options should be the value attribute of the object.
> **Example**:
>     [options]="[
>       { name: 'Apple name', value: '_apple', icon: 'home', id: 'apple_' },
>       { name: 'Banana name', value: '_banana', icon: 'bolt', id: 'banana_' },
>       { name: 'Orange name', value: '_orange', icon: 'bolt', id: 'orange_' },
>       { name: 'Pear name', value: '_pear', icon: 'info', id: 'pear_' },
>       { name: 'Grape name', value: '_grape', icon: 'bolt', id: 'grape_' },
>     ]"
> 
>     [preferredOptions]="[
>       '_grape',
>       '_orange',
>     ]"

#### ` control `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormControl `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` newFormControlByType() `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-dropdown/bmb-dropdown.stories.ts), línea **164**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the data to be displayed in the dropdown menu.
> 
> It is an array of objects representing menu items, providing additional actions or navigation options within the card button.
> 
> Each object in the array should contain the following properties:
> 
> - `icon`: (string) The name of the icon displayed next to the menu item text.
> 
> - `text`: (string) The text label for the menu item.
> 
> - `url`: (optional, string) The URL to navigate to when the menu item is clicked.
> 
> - `target`: (optional, string) Specifies where to display the linked URL (e.g., `_self`, `_blank`).
> 
> - `action`: (optional, function) A custom function executed when the menu item is clicked, this event is only emitted if the *link* property is empty. This is useful for triggering specific behaviors or events.

#### ` controlTypes `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` controlTypes `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IBmbControlType[] `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` [] `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts), línea **67**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the data list of control types.
> 
> Data descriptions:
> - ***name***: Unique identifier name for the control
> - ***type***: Type of control to render (radial, checkbox, switch, tag, dropdown'
> - ***label***: Display label for the control
> - ***checked***: Whether the control is checked/selected (for checkbox, switch, radial)
> - ***placeholder***: Placeholder text (for input/dropdown controls)
> - ***rightText***: Additional text to display on the right side
> - ***value***: Current value of the control
> - ***id***: Unique identifier for the control element
> - ***options***: Available options for selection controls (for dropdown controls)
> - ***isMultiSelect***: Whether multiple selections are allowed (for dropdown controls), when this attribute is true the list will not be filterable.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts), línea **118**.

#### ` visibilityRules `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` visibilityRules `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IBmbVisibilityRule[] `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` [] `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts), línea **76**.

**Descripción**

> Declares conditional visibility rules. Each rule specifies a `when` condition (a map of control name → expected value) and lists of control names to `show` or `hide` when the condition is met.
> 
> When a dependent control is hidden, its form value is automatically cleared.
> 
> ```ts
> visibilityRules: [
>   { when: { nivel: 'Profesional' }, show: ['tipoEval', 'escuelas'], hide: ['deptos'] },
>   { when: { nivel: 'Preparatoria' }, show: ['deptos'], hide: ['tipoEval', 'escuelas'] },
> ]
> ```

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts), línea **73**.

#### ` optionRules `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` optionRules `.
- Tipo de dato: ` IBmbOptionRule[] `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` [] `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.component.ts), línea **77**.

**Descripción**

> Declares cascading option rules. Each rule specifies a `when` condition and the new `options` to apply to the `target` dropdown when the condition is met.
> 
> If the target dropdown's current value is not in the new options list, it is automatically cleared.
> 
> ```ts
> optionRules: [
>   { when: { campus: 'Monterrey' }, target: 'carrera', options: ['Ingeniería', 'Negocios'] },
>   { when: { campus: 'Guadalajara' }, target: 'carrera', options: ['Arquitectura', 'Diseño'] },
> ]
> ```

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-filter-card/bmb-filter-card.stories.ts), línea **93**.

- Tipo de elemento: **Componente**.

- Archivo: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.component.ts).
- Carpeta `old` (legacy): **No**.

#### ` formGroup `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` formGroup `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormGroup `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` new FormGroup({}) `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.component.ts), línea **40**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormGroup` instance defined for cases where the validations are different from those already natively supported by **Bamboo inputs**.
> 
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> **Bamboo inputs** automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - isRequired: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - minlength: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - maxlength: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - max: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - min: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - pattern: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> This property is a `model` input, and for this reason can be used as:
>     [(formGroup)]="formGroup"

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-form-validator/bmb-form-validator.stories.ts), línea **160**.

>

>  - Material Symbols
>  - Rounded
>

> 
> > [!NOTE]
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> >Images are also supported; instead of the icon name, enter the URL or path of the image to use.
> 
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.
> Look for the property to set the alt, if it does not exist in the component it is because the component implements it internally.

#### ` errorMessage `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` errorMessage `.
- Tipo de dato: ` string | IBmbInputError `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` '' `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.component.ts), línea **45**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

>         if (!value) return null;
> 
>         if (value === 'value example') return { customValidation: true };
> 
>         return null;
>       };
>     }

#### ` control `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormControl `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` newFormControlByType(this.type()) `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.component.ts), línea **70**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input/bmb-input.stories.ts), línea **307**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

> Sets custom validator function to the field.
> 
> Example of a `ValidatorFn`
>     handleCustomValidator(): ValidatorFn {
>       return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
>         const { value } = control;
>         if (!value) return null;
> 
>         if (value === 'value example') return { customValidation: true };
> 
>         return null;
>       };
>     }

#### ` control `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormControl `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` new FormControl() `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-phone-number/bmb-input-phone-number.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-phone-number/bmb-input-phone-number.component.ts), línea **88**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-phone-number/bmb-input-phone-number.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-phone-number/bmb-input-phone-number.stories.ts), línea **119**.

> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

#### ` control `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` control `.
- Tipo de dato: ` FormControl `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` newFormControlByType() `.
- Mecanismo: ` model `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-tags/bmb-input-tags.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-input-tags/bmb-input-tags.component.ts), línea **86**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

> Sets the name of the left header icon. If not provided, the interactive icon will not be rendered to be displayed.
> 
> > [!CALLOUT]
> ⚙️**Configuration**
> 
> >Please refer to [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/icons?icon.size=24&icon.color=%23e8eaed&icon.style=Rounded&icon.set=Material+Symbols) for more icons and make sure that you have selected the filters:
> - Fill
> - Style:
>  - Material Symbols
>  - Rounded
> 
> ‼️These filters are important to ensure that you are choosing an icon that meets the guidelines of ***Bamboo***‼️.
> 
> > [!NOTE]
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> >Images are also supported; instead of the icon name, enter the URL or path of the image to use.
> 
> > [!WARNING]
> ⚠️**Warning**
> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.
> Look for the property to set the alt, if it does not exist in the component it is because the component implements it internally.

**Descripción**

> Sets the text format function to show the percentage in the progress bar.
>   
> 
> This property is displayed for the property type:
> 
> - counter
> - container
> 
>   The function receives two parameters: the current value and the total value, and should return a formatted string.
> 
>   If not set, it defaults to showing the value as *"value/total"*.
> 
>   ✳️**Note**
>  Avoid return HTML code, whether HTML code will be parsed.

#### ` errorMessage `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` errorMessage `.
- Tipo de dato: ` string | IBmbInputError `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` '' `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.component.ts), línea **42**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the error message instance or required field message to display below the field when there is an error in it.
> 
> For fields that only require mandatory field validation, it is sufficient to assign a string.
> 
> In case the field needs more than one validation per field, it is recommended to instantiate the error specification.
> 
> Validations supported in instantiation:
> 
> - **required**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `isRequired` property
> - **min**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `min` property, used for numeric fields
> - **max**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `max` property, used for numeric fields
> - **minLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `minlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **maxLength**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `maxlength` property, used for text and textarea fields
> - **pattern**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `pattern` property
> - **jsonFormat**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `jsonFormat` property, used for textarea fields
> - **customValidation**: corresponds to the validation assigned to the `customValidation` property
> 
> ✳️**Note**
> 
> Default error messages will be displayed if this property is not assigned correctly.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.stories.ts), línea **116**.

- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.component.ts), línea **46**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

Fuente de descripción: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.stories.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-radial/bmb-radial.stories.ts), línea **115**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the `FormControl` instance to manage the state of the field.
> 
> ℹ️**Important**
> 
> It is essential to assign the property `name` for correct behavior of the field.
> 
> It will not be necessary to define `Validators` in the `FormControl` instance, as long as the properties of this field are correctly assigned.
> 
> This component automatically implements the `Validators` on the following properties:
> 
> - **isRequired**: adds `Validators.required` to the `FormControl`
> - **minlength**: adds `Validators.minLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **maxlength**: adds `Validators.maxLength` to the `FormControl`
> - **max**: adds `Validators.max` to the `FormControl`
> - **min**: adds `Validators.min` to the `FormControl`
> - **pattern**: adds `Validators.pattern` to the `FormControl`
> 
> In ***Bamboo***, it is possible to implement automatic field validation using the `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> The `bmb-form-validator` component contains the state of the form by collecting the form fields and adding them to a `FormGroup`.
> 
> Please check the ***Form validator*** documentation for details on how to implement `bmb-form-validator` component.
> 
> This documentation is displayed as a tab at the top.

>

> 
> >Please remember that images need an *alt* to be accessible.

#### ` textFormat `

- Propiedad de la clase: ` textFormat `.
- Tipo de dato: ` BmbValueCounterFormatter `.
- Requerido: **No**.
- Valor predeterminado: ` defaultValueCounterFormatter `.
- Mecanismo: ` input `.
- Marcado como obsoleto: **No**.
- Transformación: No declarada.
- Declaración: [ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-value-counter/bmb-value-counter.component.ts](../ui-angular/src/lib/components/bmb-value-counter/bmb-value-counter.component.ts), línea **31**.

**Descripción**

> Sets the text format function to show the percentage in the progress bar.
>   
> 
> This property is displayed for the property type:
> 
> - counter
> - container
> 
>   The function receives two parameters: the current value and the total value, and should return a formatted string.
> 
>   If not set, it defaults to showing the value as *"value/total"*.
